productName: French Country 6 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table
description:
Combine abundant storage with daily convenience in the French Country 6 Drawer Dresser with Changing Table. Six spacious drawers provide room for everything your baby needs, while the attached changing table creates a dedicated, comfortable diaper station.

The changing table features safety rails and a comfortable changing height, making diaper changes easier on your back. Below, six dovetailed drawers with smooth-gliding hardware offer organized storage for clothing, blankets, diapers, and wipes. The solid wood construction and French Country detailing, including turned legs and decorative hardware, make this a piece you will be proud to have in your nursery.

Non-toxic, baby-safe finishes throughout.
